title: Sexy Sausage Pasta
method: Remove skins from sausages and fry meat until browned and crispy.
Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Add cooked pasta water to adjust sauce consistency.
Add diced onion and garlic to sausages; cook 5 mins.
Add sliced leek, then peppers after 5 mins.
Pour in chopped tomatoes and simmer.
Deglaze with red wine and balsamic vinegar.
Toss pasta into sauce and serve.
